title: Lighting
summary: Controls the look of the world: time of day (ClockTime), ambient colors, fog, technology, and post-processing effects (Atmosphere, BloomEffect, ColorCorrectionEffect…) parented inside it.

properties.name: ClockTime
properties.description: Time of day, 0–24 (14 = 2pm). Tween it for smooth day/night cycles.

properties.name: FogColor / FogStart / FogEnd
properties.description: Distance fog: color and the range where it fades in.

details.heading: Effect objects live INSIDE Lighting
details.body: Atmosphere, Sky, BloomEffect, BlurEffect, ColorCorrectionEffect, DepthOfFieldEffect, SunRaysEffect, Terrain — parenting these instances into Lighting activates them game-wide.

explanation.whatItIs: The world's moods dial: time of day, haze, glow, color grade. One service, and everything the player sees passes through it.
explanation.whyItExists: Atmosphere sells a game. Lighting centralizes environment control so one system can move day to night, clear skies to fog.
whenToUse: Zone moods: fog in swamps, warm tint at sunset (ColorCorrectionEffect)
Post-processing: Bloom for neon, DepthOfField for menus
whenNotToUse: Per-object lighting — use PointLight/SurfaceLight/SpotLight instances on parts instead
Client-only visual fakes that should not change real lighting for everyone (do those client-side with effects)
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Lighting
 ├─ Properties: ClockTime, FogEnd, Brightness…
 ├─ Sky (instance)            ← skybox
 ├─ Atmosphere (instance)     ← haze/scattering
 ├─ BloomEffect (instance)    ← glow
 └─ ColorCorrectionEffect     ← color grade
Parent an effect in → it applies game-wide.
```
tips: Smooth day/night: TweenService on ClockTime, or increment in Heartbeat
Swap ColorCorrection presets per zone for instant mood changes
Test with Technology = Future for the best shadows if your game supports it
commonMistakes: Setting ClockTime every frame on the server without smoothing — jumpy sun
Adding effects in workspace instead of Lighting — they won't activate
Forgetting Lighting changes on the server replicate to ALL clients

examples.title: Simple day/night cycle
examples.code:
-- Server Script
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local MINUTES_PER_CYCLE = 10   -- full day in 10 minutes

local DAY_MINUTES = 24 * 60
local secondsPerMinute = (MINUTES_PER_CYCLE * 60) / DAY_MINUTES

while true do
    Lighting.ClockTime += 1 / 60        -- one in-game minute
    task.wait(secondsPerMinute)
end

examples.title: Foggy swamp zone
examples.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local function enterSwamp()
    Lighting.FogStart = 0
    Lighting.FogEnd = 120
    Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 140, 120)
end

local function leaveSwamp()
    Lighting.FogEnd = 100000   -- effectively off
end
